data.one_liner: Static analysis suite with 2300+ custom lint rules for Flutter and Dart
data.what_it_does: Provides over 2,300 custom lint rules and quick fixes to detect memory leaks, runtime crashes, security vulnerabilities, and accessibility issues. Integrates with the Dart analysis server and includes a VS Code extension for project health and rule management.
use_when: You want to enforce security, performance, and lifecycle rules beyond standard lints
You want to catch memory leaks like undisposed controllers or setState after dispose
You are using VS Code and want an extension to triage violations and track code health
avoid_when: Your project uses a Dart SDK version below 3.11.0
You prefer an extremely minimal lint set with zero custom rules
strengths: Massive rule coverage spanning security, accessibility, performance, and lifecycle
Provides tier presets (essential, recommended, professional, comprehensive, pedantic)
Includes library-specific rules for popular packages like Riverpod, Bloc, GetX, and Firebase
weaknesses: Large number of rules may introduce high noise or friction initially without careful tier selection
Tied ecosystem with its own companion VS Code extension for full management features
data.setup_notes: Add as a dev dependency and include the chosen tier preset in analysis_options.yaml.

alternatives.name: flutter_lints
alternatives.why_pick_it: You want the official, lightweight, zero-configuration linter recommended by the Flutter team.

alternatives.name: lints
alternatives.why_pick_it: You want the official Dart linting rules with minimal overhead.
